# Mangia Brick Oven Pizza

> Family-run, New York-style pizzeria and Italian restaurant with three New Jersey locations — Toms River, Jackson, and Shrewsbury. Brick-oven pizza, Italian classics, online ordering, catering, and private events.

Mangia Brick Oven Pizza serves fresh, New York-style pizza with Sicilian roots. Each location offers dine-in, takeout, online ordering, catering trays and party packages, and private event hosting.

## Locations

- [Toms River](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/toms-river): 1 Rt. 37 West, Toms River, NJ 08753 — (732) 557-5000
- [Jackson](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/jackson): 10 Leesville Road, Jackson, NJ 08527 — (732) 276-7200
- [Shrewsbury](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/shrewsbury): 1087 Broad St, Shrewsbury, NJ 07702 — (732) 578-9000
- [All locations](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/locations): Addresses, hours, and online ordering for every location

## Menus & Offers

- [Menus](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/menus): Dining, takeout, and catering menus for all three locations
- [2 for $40 — Toms River](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/2-for-40-toms-river): Four-course dine-in dinner for two, Monday–Thursday
- [2 for $40 — Jackson](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/2-for-40-jackson): Four-course dine-in dinner for two, Monday–Thursday

## Catering & Private Events

- [Catering](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/catering): Pizza and Italian catering — trays, party packages, offices and gatherings
- [Private Events](https://www.mangiabrickovenpizza.com/private-events): Birthdays, showers, corporate parties, and holiday events at all three locations
